entries.title: Ink Droplet Spreading in a Still Water Cube
entries.description: A small colored ink sphere is released at the center of a transparent water-filled box, breaking into many tiny particles that slowly diffuse outward in random motion, fading in color as they spread and leaving a transient trail cloud.

entries.title: Colored Ink Plumes in a Flowing Stream
entries.description: A long transparent channel contains a slow laminar water flow while several narrow nozzles inject red, blue, and yellow ink threads that stretch, twist, mix, and form layered plumes tracked by faint particle trails and a side-panel showing a mixing index.

entries.title: Hot and Cold Ink Convection in a Glass Tank
entries.description: A tall transparent tank shows warm, light ink released at the bottom and cool, dense ink released at the top, with both plumes rising or sinking, curling into vortex rings that collide, merge, and diffuse, with temperature indicated by color gradients.

entries.title: Ink Diffusion Around Rotating Obstacles
entries.description: A clear rectangular aquarium holds stationary and slowly rotating transparent cylinders while a central ink droplet diffuses, gets wrapped into spirals by the rotating obstacles, and leaves streaky trails that reveal the flow patterns.

entries.title: Microscopic Ink Molecules in a Lattice
entries.description: A cubic lattice of invisible “cells” contains thousands of tiny colored spheres representing ink molecules that perform 3D random walks, bounce off the box walls, and gradually spread from a dense cluster into a uniform cloud, with a side meter tracking concentration over time.

entries.title: Ink Diffusion from a Porous Sponge Block

entries.title: Dropping Ink into a Rotating Vortex Column
